steps.name: Dark Stalker (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Geas] in the “Burning City,” go to [Iris] in the “Frozen World.”

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You could have just passed me by, but when I saw you coming, I definitely felt something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. I somehow feel like I need to talk to Geass... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You don't have to worry about it alone. He has guided everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it were him… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The one who became everything to you on your journey.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The goddess is waiting. Come on to the frozen world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris’s heart… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yes, go find him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, see you next time.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: There you were. What's going on? It's unlikely you'll ever get inside here.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: %s has entered a frozen world.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The goddess called.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Can I talk to him?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: If you are a descendant of Karion, you must know this.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I think it's still too early... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You still think differently from me. It was like that when I received that necklace from Leda... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Oh, the necklace... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I hope that your choice of necklace is not unfortunate.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: Dark Stalker (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] at “God’s Tree, Lapier” and obtain <Seed of Illusion>. Then report to [Iris] in the "Frozen World".

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… . I heard you called.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Do you remember when you started traveling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I arrived at Belos and read the memory of Iris in the stone tower.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No, before that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I, I… . In Luman… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (Iris reaches out and touches his forehead. After a moment, a warm feeling permeates his entire body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I am… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Do you remember a little bit now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Different memories from what happened at Zenadia….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's me... . So I... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Heir to the Count Carion family, %s… . Due to an attack by the Deimos Church, the territory fell into their hands.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Count fought against the Church to protect you, his successor. And he entrusted you to Jiscard's disciple Ul.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. The night everything I had collapsed, I came to Luman with Ul's help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I tried endlessly to become stronger, but it wasn't easy. So I asked Jiscard to become my disciple, but he didn't accept me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, follow my advice and travel… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… , why did i forget this? Have you lost your memory?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No. It wasn't a memory, it was just that something was blocking everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So I called. I need to know that, and %s also needs to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's not difficult. Would you like to find and bring back the ‘Seed of Illusion’ from Gaia’s residence? It is different from the illusion tree seed that Tractus has.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, okay… . I'll be back soon.

steps.name: Dark Stalker (3)
steps.objective: Go to [Yuran] at the “Luman Coalition Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I waited. This is the seed of illusion... . Gaia also hopes that the Seed of Illusion will help %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia? How do you know Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I learned a certain amount after inheriting the power of the Holy God from Ceres.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So I'm going to talk about it. Now, little by little, I want to get to the front of %s. Now, look… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (The seed of illusion in Iris's hand melts and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think I know a little bit now. The power that was given to you, that power was holding you back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power I have is enough to receive God's protection... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Think about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, okay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I closed my eyes and waited a little while, and an unknown afterimage came to mind.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Can you see it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, yeah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice… . Weiss wants something. Wait, I have the power that Weiss wants?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power of the Karion family... . For that purpose, the Church of Deimos came out and brought everyone… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, please explain. What is this… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Karion family had a power that couldn't be explained in words. Maybe that's what Vice needed. So he always did… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. So keep talking. Please don't stop... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think some people were influenced by the twisted people who stayed in Eastland a long time ago. It’s a kind of ‘power’.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Although it may not be superhuman strength, such strength has been passed down from generation to generation to the successors of the Karion family. The vise is in the desired shape... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it like bondage?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Maybe you wanted to complete it... . But now he doesn't remember. That force has now stopped you, %s, from becoming a true Chaser.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What the heck… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The blessings of Ceres and Gaia, the traces of power I received from superhumans, and the power of Karion within %s reacted.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: In order not to be influenced separately by all the powerful beings in the world... . Especially from Vice... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Weiss cannot believe that the person she is facing now is the heir to the Karion family.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, it would be nice to just protect you from Weiss, but it also affected the people I knew in Luman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that was it. It didn’t feel unfamiliar… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What? However, I am not the one who should be thankful. Since you are GIS CARD… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does the sword spirit already know...?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If you have a chance later, talk to them in person. Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah! %s, Yuran is looking for you. Would you like to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you looking for me? Hmm, what’s going on… . Iris Then, let’s meet officially later on in a good way. I'll look forward to it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… , see you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you found it.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Tried to find %s, but didn't talk to anyone. You have been to the world of imagination.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It wasn't a big deal, but the teacher asked me to prepare a seat for him. I will step aside for a moment, so please speak with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s wait a bit.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Here it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it’s my first time meeting you… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Nice to meet you. Heir of Karion... . Thank you for persevering through this time.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: After today's meeting, I might treat you again as if I'm seeing you for the first time. You know that too, so I ask for your understanding in advance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: To some extent, you probably know this because you heard it from the Goddess Iris... ? I should have paid more attention to Count Carion, and I'm sorry I didn't.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ul led his forces and took you and a few other survivors, but it was for the best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for saving me.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You can tell that to me rather than to me. Because I really thought about you... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Anyway… .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: When I think about that time, my heart feels heavy. When the county fell, I remembered what happened in my hometown... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you so much for holding on so well. I also want to praise you for not being obsessed with power.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I am glad that the image of rushing in to become a disciple has disappeared, and that I have now been reborn as a follower of the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Anyway, I came to tell you this. Thank you. I wish you all the best in the future. Many difficult things will come your way in the future... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Now I'm going back Don't be sorry if you don't remember. And later, when everything is over, come see me again.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: When that time comes, I might be able to remember again... .

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will go too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Thank you, Karion’s power… You blocked me from everyone to protect me…)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Yes, even if everyone forgets, I remember. With this memory, I will continue to follow Iris.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Although I won't say that other people don't remember or feel bad about it.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: (Giscard looks at the back of %s leaving the coalition headquarters.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, you can do as you wish... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Master. When did you come? I thought you would be a little late this time.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes, Yuran. I came quickly because I had work to do. Nothing much has happened so far, right?
